meta.volume: Pinterest 'people searched this' (rounded by Pinterest) read from pinterest.com/ideas pages via TinyFish search snippets. Keywords without a visible count were skipped (volume null only for noted pages).
meta.competition_method: Top-10 Pinterest results (TinyFish search, site:pinterest.com, US). exact = results whose title contains the phrase; fresh = results dated 2026; filler = ideas pages/shopping pins. Rated Low/Medium/High by hand. Checked for the top 2-4 keywords per niche by volume (plus a few extras); other keywords have competition null (not checked).
meta.trend_method: trends.pinterest.com logged-out 'Trends in the spotlight' and Editors' Picks (MoM growth). These had no visible search count so are listed as trend_signals, not ranked keywords.
meta.new_or_rising_rule: new = keyword text not found in any earlier JSON in the repo; rising = has Pinterest Trends MoM growth. No earlier keywords-daily files existed, so this is the baseline run.
meta.engagement_note: Pin saves not visible logged out; search volume is the demand signal.
